title: Plots of density and magnitude (size) of an object showing possible relationship
description: Hand-plotted graph on graph paper, printed sideways, titled "PLOTS OF DENSITY AND MAGNITUDE (SIZE) OF AN OBJECT SHOWING POSSIBLE RELATIONSHIP". Three side-by-side traces plot two magnitude measurements and a density measurement against film frame number (0 to 100). Stamped CONFIDENTIAL SECURITY INFORMATION; part of a photographic film analysis of an unidentified object.
